value.rationale: The quotient by simultaneous reversal of every directed path is a natural orientation-forgetting operation on multipath configuration spaces. The result gives exact integral operator identities in every length, a sharp four-divisibility criterion for the extra two-dimensional rational quotient homology, and a uniform nontrivial fundamental group. It is a family-level topological classification, not a rerun of existing ordinary Betti ranks or a parameter-tweaked table. The surprising equality a*=-rho*^2 holds integrally despite geometrically distinct transformations; this is useful in equivariant calculations.
